---
title: "Brazil Visuals For Project 2 Checkpoint 2"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(dplyr)
complete_data <- read.csv("complete_data.csv")

Brazil_data <- read.csv("Brazil_Weather.csv")
```

```{r}
Brazilian_cases <- complete_data %>%
  filter(country == "Brazil") %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(measles_total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Percent = Value / sum(Value) * 100, 
         dataset = "Annual Measles Case (%) by Month")

weather <- Brazil_data %>%
  mutate(month = 1:12, Val = Precipitation..mm., 
         dataset = "Annual Precipitation (%) by Month") %>%
  mutate(Percent = Val / sum(Val) * 100) %>%
  select(month, Percent, dataset)

combined_values <- bind_rows(Brazilian_cases, weather) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  mutate(fill_color = case_when(
    Percent == max(Percent) ~ "High",
    Percent == min(Percent) ~ "Low",
    TRUE ~ "Normal")) %>%
  ungroup()

AnimatedGraph <- ggplot(combined_values, aes(x = month, y = Percent)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "gray40") +
  geom_point(aes(color = fill_color), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High" = "red", "Low" = "blue", "Normal" = "gray"),
                    breaks = c("High", "Normal", "Low"),
                    name = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "{closest_state}",
    subtitle = "Red = peak month | Blue = lowest month",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Percentage of Annual Total (%)"
  ) +
  transition_states(dataset) +
  theme_bw()

animate(AnimatedGraph, nframes = 100, fps = 10)

```
